title: Quick Pan-Seared Italian Goose Frittata
description: Sweet and snappy weeknight Italian dish featuring goose fat. Egg-free friendly and easy to make in a kazán or cauldron.
instructions: Heat goose fat in a large kazán or cauldron over medium-high heat until it reaches 375°F (190°C).
Add chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 3 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cook for another minute, until fragrant.
Add cooked khao khua and stir to combine.
Crack in the goose meat and stir until it's broken up into small pieces.
Season with salt and pepper to taste, then stir in chopped parsley and grated Parmesan.
Pour the mixture into a greased plate or ring mold and cook until the edges are golden brown and the center is set, about 5-6 minutes per side.
Remove from heat and let it rest for a few minutes before slicing and serving.
